and that the LORD your God
verseText: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm.
meaning: God wanted his people to never forget how he rescued them. In the same way, we should never forget how Jesus rescued us.
